$comment: Optional Ranger config file passed via RANGER_CONFIG_FILE. Limits may be lowered but never exceed the documented ceilings. approvedSnapshotRoots lists the operator-approved synthetic roots whose local git worktrees may be inspected for repository snapshots (empty/absent denies local inspection). providers.traceRoot (default: the sibling ../trace of this repository) and providers.traceHome (default: ~/.cache/ranger-trace) may be set to absolute paths to relocate Trace.
